creator: Dhruv Rathee Shorts
title: What Would Happen If the Sun Disappeared?

script.about: Explaining the catastrophic physical and biological consequences if the Sun suddenly disappeared from the solar system.

beats.said: What would happen if the Sun disappeared from our world?
beats.shows: Presenter introducing hypothetical question with fiery Sun CGI in hands

beats.said: First we would only find out after eight point five minutes.
beats.shows: Sunlight traveling across space to Earth with 8.5 MINUTES text

beats.said: After nine minutes, Earth would be enveloped in complete darkness.
beats.shows: Earth passing into total darkness in space

beats.said: The Moon would become invisible because it only reflects sunlight.
beats.shows: Moon seen through night clouds then fading to darkness

beats.said: Without the gravitational pull,
beats.shows: Flash effect of vanishing Sun

beats.said: Earth would fly in a forward motion,
beats.shows: Earth speeding forward through starfield

beats.said: escaping the solar system
beats.shows: 2D diagram of planetary orbits with Earth breaking away

beats.said: into outer space.
beats.shows: Vortex accretion disk in deep outer space

beats.said: Within a year,
beats.shows: Field of asteroids floating through cosmos

beats.said: temperatures would drop lower than minus seventy degrees Celsius.
beats.shows: Blizzard in pine forest with -70C thermometer gauge

beats.said: This means all oceans would freeze.
beats.shows: Presenter explaining frozen oceans in front of sun CGI

beats.said: Since only top layers freeze,
beats.shows: Deep sea hydrothermal vent structure underwater

beats.said: the bottom layers would stay insulated with liquid water.
beats.shows: Animation of frozen glacial surface

beats.said: Because of this, deep sea life
beats.shows: Chunky ice sheets drifting on water

beats.said: could survive
beats.shows: Sharks swimming in dark ocean depth

beats.said: for thousands of years without the Sun.
beats.shows: Vent shrimp swarming on ocean floor rock

beats.said: However on land,
beats.shows: Presenter gesturing in front of glowing background

beats.said: all trees would slowly die without photosynthesis.
beats.shows: Bare barren dead trees standing in cold ground

beats.said: Plants would fail to function.
beats.shows: Dried shriveled sunflower head in cold field

beats.said: Extreme cold would collapse the atmosphere.
beats.shows: Fog and thick clouds shrouding mountain ridge

beats.said: In the long term,
beats.shows: Snow blowing heavily past residential window panes

beats.said: human survival would be next to impossible in this situation.
beats.shows: Presenter delivering conclusion with hands folded in front of sun

beats.said: Everything would go dark.
beats.shows: Earth and extinguished sun vanishing into black abyss
